scope: Connects verified automatic WhatsApp conversations to the assigned advisor's Scheduling availability without exposing a direct model booking tool.

The reasoning adapter can classify only a missing-date prompt or a bounded availability date/timezone request. Server code validates the channel, lead assignment, published advisor team, calendar and feature permission, then renders up to three current slots.

A customer selects an offered slot by number and must then send an exact six-digit confirmation code. The appointment is created only after that second message through the same idempotency, calendar-revision and exclusion-constraint path used by staff bookings.
Adds a default-off published Settings permission and a separate deployment switch. Existing releases remain disabled. Customer cancellation and rescheduling are not enabled by this slice.

securityAndConsistency.authorization: Requires WHATSAPP_BOOKING_ENABLED=true, an enabled allowlisted channel, automatic bot ownership, an open lead assigned to an advisor in the latest published team, a saved advisor calendar and appointmentBookingEnabled=true in the latest published Settings release.
securityAndConsistency.confirmation: Offers are tenant/channel/lead/conversation/source-event/ownership-version bound, expire after 30 minutes, and selections expire after 15 minutes. Confirmation codes are stored only as SHA-256 digests and expire after five failed attempts.
securityAndConsistency.atomicity: The confirmation receipt, appointment insert, immutable mutation result, lead timeline note, offer state and outbound confirmation are committed in one tenant transaction. A booking success message cannot be dispatched without the committed appointment reference.
securityAndConsistency.conflicts: The shared scheduling path locks the request key and advisor calendar, revalidates the exact offered UTC instant and calendar revision, and relies on the database exclusion constraint for competing requests.
securityAndConsistency.ownership: Takeover, pause, opt-out, lead closure, assignment changes and response-policy changes prevent or cancel active offers through existing ownership/version controls and the new offer trigger.
securityAndConsistency.providerBoundary: No provider receives an executable appointment tool. The model output is treated as a bounded intent; availability and mutation authority remain server-owned.

deployment: Apply migration 122 with the normal Runtime migration-owner process after migration 121.
Deploy the Runtime image, Business Manager backend/reply worker and frontend, then restart the reply worker so the new reasoner contract is active.

Keep WHATSAPP_BOOKING_ENABLED unset/false initially. In Leads & Conversations Settings enable confirmed WhatsApp appointment booking, save and publish; verify the lead is assigned to an active published advisor with configured Scheduling hours.
After test-number validation, set WHATSAPP_BOOKING_ENABLED=true and verify offer, selection, wrong-code, expiry, conflict and final-confirmation behavior before any customer pilot.
